title: Define session and attempt domain types for Harus runtime
acceptance: SessionKind supports quiz, exam, and practice
Session carries quiz_id/exam_id/filter and server-owned affects_rating
AttemptResponse covers mc, tf, short, essay, and code response shapes
notes: Promoted carried spike domain types and reconciled them with spec §4.9/§4.10. HTTP lifecycle and DB persistence remain in P5-005/P5-006.

title: Implement five-kind grader registry and outcomes
acceptance: QuestionKind and payload structs cover mc, tf, short, essay, and code
Deterministic graders handle mc, tf, and short
Essay returns pending-manual for valid manual responses
Code v1 supports exemplar exact-match and pending when runner is absent
GradeOutcome exposes correct, points_awarded, max, and note
notes: Replaced old mcq/free_text/cloze grader spike with Harus five-kind pure grading logic and unit coverage. DB migration constraints still need the Plan 2/3 schema rewrite before DB tests can exercise all five kinds.

title: Port Elo update math and property tests
acceptance: Calibration phase freezes user ratings while moving item ratings
Mature phase uses narrower K factors
Property tests cover finite bounds, sign, and mature equal-K conservation
Sessions with affects_rating=false have a clear skip point for lifecycle integration
notes: Carried spike Elo module remains pure and covered by unit/property tests; lifecycle skip is wired when P5-005/P5-006 add session execution.

title: Port planner sampling scaffold
acceptance: Planner samples live questions without replacement
Recent exclusions work for the user
MC option_order snapshots are generated for shuffled choices
StudyPlan endpoint algorithm is ready to expand from weak tags
notes: Existing quiz planner scaffold was updated from mcq/free_text naming to mc/short. It still plans directly from the bank and should be adapted to quiz/practice/session entrypoints as lifecycle routes land.

title: Implement session lifecycle service
acceptance: POST /sessions body variants can hydrate quiz, exam, or practice plans
deadline_at is computed for timed sessions
answer replay is idempotent on session_id and question_id
finish marks sessions finished and computes result
affects_rating=false skips Elo updates
notes: Added pure engine::sessions lifecycle service for quiz/exam/practice start validation, timed deadlines, answer idempotency by session question, grading integration, affects_rating=false Elo skip, and finish result aggregation. Persistence and HTTP hydration stay in P5-006 because the current migration is still the older schema shape.

title: Add session and attempt HTTP routes
acceptance: POST /v1/sessions accepts quizId, examId, or practice bodies
POST /v1/sessions/{id}/answer stores and grades one answer
POST /v1/sessions/{id}/finish returns result
Answers after deadline return 410 exam_expired
OpenAPI snapshot reflects the routes
notes: Practice path is implemented and DB-backed: POST /v1/sessions plans live bank questions, /answer stores and grades one answer idempotently, /finish persists result, OpenAPI regenerated, and api/tests/sessions.rs roundtrips through local Postgres. quizId/examId bodies currently return 422 with explicit messages because real hydration depends on P4 quiz tables and P6 exam_sections.

title: Plan 5 validation pass
acceptance: One golden-path grading test per kind passes
One negative grading test per deterministic kind passes
Session body variants have E2E coverage
Calibration vs mature Elo curve checked against fixtures
Planner produces a non-empty plan from synthetic history
make check and make test-engine pass
notes: Use this as the merge checkpoint before Plan 6 exams/composition work.
